maria: quick brief for a 1-pager aimed at security-conscious enterprises. goal: single-sheet with top blurb, 3 proof bullets, micro SLA, 1-line migration, and webinar CTA.
elaine: include lead routing tags: region, deploy_choice, compliance. sales needs copyable email line.
sam: benchmark bullets (draft): "p95 ~130-150ms on quantized 13B chat; cost ~0.6x self-hosted with caching; canary rollouts reduced regressions ~15% (internal)."
raj: add KMS/HSM + audit logs note. mention fallback routing for capacity.
maria: webinar seed: "Deploying LLMs with Security & SLAs" + short desc + CTA. form fields: name,email,company,region,deploy_choice,compliance_need,expected_qps.
opsbot: sample routing:
```yaml
- if region == "EU": owner: "EMEA_AE"
- if deploy_choice == "private" and compliance_need == "hipaa": owner: "Health_AE"
- else: owner: "Growth_AE"
```
elaine: timeline: finalize copy Thu COB; design Fri. maria owns copy; elaine owns routing; sam finalizes numbers; raj approves security.
maria: thanks — aim to push to field next week. tagging salesops for visibility. opsbot: schedule campaign "enterprise-brief-216000" start 2160050000.
